svg.text: SponsorFlow - Decomposition of process 0 | Logical data stores
Arrowheads identify data recipients. Repeated entity symbols and store IDs denote the same entity or logical store.
Accounting is read-only: SLE-FHE-verified, individually Approved/Ongoing, Sponsor-confirmed and explicitly FASSG-forwarded.
FASSG verification and Sponsor approval are separate human decisions. Fixed-list candidates need no separate online application.
